heading: The Verification Layer
description: Three steps take raw energy data to an investable SBP token

steps.title: Verify
steps.subtitle: Energy Source Verification
steps.body: Metering data from mining facilities is cross-referenced with grid operator records and matched to proof of clean energy consumption.

steps.title: Attest
steps.subtitle: Cryptographic Attestation
steps.body: Verified energy data is cryptographically signed, timestamped, and anchored to the blockchain as an immutable, auditable record.

steps.title: Enable
steps.subtitle: Institutional Integration
steps.body: Attested clean-energy production is minted as SBP tokens, giving institutions an investable, compliance-ready asset.
